Mozilla CA bundle — vendored, embedded into the binary at build time
====================================================================

Source:  https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem (Mozilla-derived CA bundle)
SHA-256: a41b5d356aea97a529fe27e0f7316d2f9d946d75927476cf9cf1b90637d00505
Mozilla data as of: Fri Sep 25 03:12:01 2026 GMT

The panel never reads a system CA path (dev.md §2): trust comes from this
file, converted to a C array by scripts/gen-trust-store.py during the
build ($(BUILD)/generated/trust_store.cpp). Updating the bundle is a
deliberate commit: replace the PEM, recompute this manifest, state the
new "Mozilla as of" date.

Why not fetch at build time: the build must not depend on the network,
and the trust set must be reviewable in-tree before it is built in.
